probability_drift_counterexample.conclusion: Absolute probability drift alone cannot bound log-loss drift by 1e-4.

order_averaging_counterexample.conclusion: Jensen does not guarantee improvement over the original orientation alone.

arithmetic_prevalence_algebra.conclusion: Prevalence alone supplies no numerical log-loss ceiling; affected baseline loss is also required. No hidden prevalence or gain is estimated.
